title: Betrayal at House on the Hill
description: A 3-6 player horror exploration board game. Enter a growing haunted house, explore rooms, find items and omens, then survive the haunt by following the scenario goals.

scenario.title: First Scenario
scenario.objective: Explore before the haunt; after it begins, learn the mummy's true name, learn the banishment spell, and banish the mummy before the wedding is completed.
scenario.heroGoal: Find the true name in the sarcophagus room, Study, or Library; have the Book holder learn the spell; bring the Book to the mummy and win the Sanity contest.
scenario.traitorGoal: Help the mummy take the Girl plus either the Holy Symbol or Ring back to the sarcophagus. The traitor also wins if every hero dies.
scenario.monsterGoal: The mummy is a monster with Might 8, Speed 3, and Sanity 5. Heroes learn the true name, learn the banishment spell, and banish the mummy; the traitor helps the mummy return to the sarcophagus with the Girl and either the Holy Symbol or Ring.
scenario.readerLead: Heroes find the true name, learn the spell, and banish the mummy with Sanity; the traitor helps the mummy return to the sarcophagus with the Girl and either the Holy Symbol or Ring.

reader.prologue:
Dry scraping comes from the sarcophagus. The mummy wakes, turns toward the Girl, and every step through the house starts to feel like a march toward a wedding that should never happen.

The explorer who revealed the haunt becomes the traitor and remains in the game.
reader.setup:
Place the mummy and the sarcophagus in the traitor's room. Set the Girl omen aside from its holder, then place the Girl marker in a discovered room far from the mummy.

Prepare 2 knowledge tokens: the first means the true name is found, and the second means the banishment spell is learned. After setup, the player to the traitor's left takes the first turn.
reader.heroManual:
Heroes complete two knowledge steps in order. First, make a 6+ Knowledge roll in the sarcophagus room, Study, or Library to find the mummy's true name and gain the first knowledge token.

After the true name is found, the hero holding the Book may make a 6+ Knowledge roll to learn the banishment spell and gain the second knowledge token. Then the Book must reach the mummy's room before any hero in that room can attempt the final banishment.
reader.circleManual:
The final banishment is a Sanity contest against the mummy. It is available only after the heroes have 2 knowledge tokens, the spell is learned, and a living hero with the Book is in the mummy's room.

If the hero's Sanity total is strictly higher than the mummy's Sanity total, the heroes win.
reader.traitorManual:
The traitor helps the mummy take the Girl, then bring the Girl and either the Holy Symbol or Ring back to the sarcophagus room.

Explorers can pick up the Girl, give the Girl to the Mummy in the same room, and give the Holy Symbol or Ring to the Mummy in the same room. The traitor wins when the Mummy returns to the sarcophagus with the Girl and either required omen. The traitor also wins if every hero dies.
reader.spiritManual:
The mummy is a monster with Might 8, Speed 3, and Sanity 5. It is not stunned by normal attacks, and heroes may not make Speed attacks against it.

When rolling for the mummy's movement, a result of 0 or 1 lets it move instantly to any room in the house. The mummy can carry items and can steal instead of dealing damage.
reader.exorcismManual:
Runtime actions open by progress: find the true name, learn the banishment spell, then banish the mummy.

Each hero can attempt only one haunt special action per turn. The Book must be in the final room, but the hero who starts the banishment does not have to personally hold it.
reader.endingManual:
Heroes win by finding the true name, learning the spell, and banishing the mummy with Sanity.

The traitor wins when the mummy returns to the sarcophagus with the Girl and either the Holy Symbol or Ring, or when all heroes die.

mummyRampage.title: Mummy Rampage
mummyRampage.objective: Heroes learn the true name, learn the spell, and banish the Mummy before the wedding is completed.
mummyRampage.heroGoal: Find the true name, learn the spell with the Book, then use Sanity to banish the Mummy.
mummyRampage.traitorGoal: Help the Mummy carry the Girl and the Holy Symbol or Ring back to the Sarcophagus room.
mummyRampage.nextFallback: Find the true name, learn the spell, or reach the Mummy

reader.prologue: Dry scraping comes from the sarcophagus. The mummy wakes, turns toward the Girl, and every step through the house starts to feel like a march toward a wedding that should never happen.
reader.prologueHeroes: Dust suddenly swirls through the room, and a shadow of dread crosses your mind. Not far away, you hear a friend's cry, mixed with fear and a trace of excitement. A strange, deep voice echoes in your head: "My beloved was lost in the ancient flood. Though my tears have turned to ash, love still burns in my heart like the sun. Now my love has returned. We shall never be parted! Anyone who stops me will die, body and soul!"
reader.prologueTraitor:
There is a crack in the wall. When you touch it, the wall slides aside, revealing a dusty sarcophagus covered in strange designs. The markings on the sarcophagus glow faintly, and you cannot help studying what must be ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs.

A strange, deep voice flashes through your mind: "My beloved was lost in the ancient flood. Though my tears have turned to ash, love still burns in my heart like the sun. Now my love has returned. We shall never be parted! You will not stop our union!" Your mind goes blank. You know only that, to let true lovers be together, sacrificing your friends is worthwhile. The sarcophagus slowly opens, and you gaze devoutly upon your master.
reader.setup:
Your character has become the traitor but continues playing.

Take the large Mummy monster token and a pentagonal item token, which represents the sarcophagus, and place them in your room.

You immediately lose the Girl companion. Discard the Girl omen and lose its effect. Set the Girl omen aside, take a magenta token to represent the Girl, and place it in another room on the same floor as the Mummy. The Girl and Mummy must be at least 5 rooms apart. If the floor is too small for that, place the Girl token in the room farthest from the Mummy.
reader.heroes:
The traitor is trying to complete the wedding between the Mummy and the Girl.

Banish the Mummy back to the land of the dead before the Mummy marries the Girl.
reader.traitor:
They are trying to banish the Mummy back to the land of the dead.

The Mummy must hold the Girl omen and either the Holy Symbol omen or the Ring omen, then return to the room with the sarcophagus token. If all heroes die, you also win. Check whether the Holy Symbol omen or Ring omen has been discovered. If neither has been discovered, then when you explore a new room and reveal an omen, search the omen deck for the Holy Symbol or Ring. Then shuffle the omen deck.
reader.monster:
Speed 3, Might 8, Sanity 5

When rolling for the Mummy's movement, if the result is 0 or 1, the Mummy may instantly move to any room in the house. The Mummy can carry items like a normal character and can steal. Items do not change the Mummy's traits. If you are in the same room as the Mummy, you may give the Girl omen or any item to the Mummy.

If the Mummy is in the same room as any hero, it must attack that hero if possible.

The Mummy attacks only with Might. A defeated hero must reduce Speed first. Only when Speed has reached its lowest value may that hero reduce Might. When a character's Might reaches the skull symbol, that character is dead.

Whenever the Mummy successfully deals 2 or more damage, the player may choose to steal one item from the opponent instead; that opponent does not reduce any traits. The Mummy can take the Girl omen this way.

Any Speed attack against the Mummy has no effect, including Dynamite and the Revolver.
reader.endingHeroes:
As you close the Book, hot winds swirl around you. The Mummy staggers toward you, weak hands closing around your neck. You stare into its desperate eyes, and in an instant the Mummy scatters like fine sand in the wind. In your ears you hear: wife, beloved, all gone like smoke...

When the hot wind stops, you look around and find yourself alone.
reader.endingTraitor:
The little girl cowers in the corner, her tearful eyes begging for mercy.

The Mummy slowly walks to the girl. With withered hands it gently lifts her, ignores her cries, and blows into her mouth. Her sobbing fades. Her eyes roll back, faintly glowing yellow.

"My priest, my beloved..." the girl sings in the Mummy's arms. "Soon the whole world will bow beneath us. Their flesh will burn for us. Their souls will feast us..."

crimsonJack.title: Crimson Jack Returns
crimsonJack.objective: Heroes investigate Jack, prepare circles, and exorcise; the traitor hunts heroes.
crimsonJack.heroGoal: Investigate Jack and circles, then exorcise Jack's Spirit.
crimsonJack.traitorGoal: Stop the exorcism and make every hero fall.
crimsonJack.nextFallback: Investigate Jack or study a circle

reader.prologue:
Parents once warned children about Crimson Jack: stay out too late and he would come for you.

As the explorers speak about the killer, one companion smiles in a way that feels wrong. The explorer who revealed the haunt is the traitor.
reader.setup:
The heroes have no extra setup. After the haunt begins, the player to the traitor's left takes the first turn.

Needed tokens: Jack's Spirit, 2 Sanity tokens as exorcism circles, and 2 Might tokens as Knowledge of Jack.
reader.heroes:
Heroes investigate Jack and study exorcism circles. A hero in the Library may Learn about Jack; a hero on an Event-symbol tile may Study the Exorcism.

Jack's Spirit appears only after the traitor falls; a hero who has learned about Jack gains a bonus when attacking the traitor. Once Jack's Spirit appears, a hero on the same tile may attempt the final Sanity exorcism. Circles improve that roll.
reader.special:
A successful study places an exorcism circle on the current tile. If both circles are already placed, move one to the current tile instead.

Each circle in the same region helps the final exorcism.
reader.traitor:
The traitor wins when every hero is dead. At the start of the haunt, the traitor heals all traits and improves physical traits.

The traitor should slow investigation, block circles, and attack heroes. If the traitor dies, Jack's Spirit appears and keeps the pressure on.
reader.monster:
When the traitor dies, place Jack's Spirit on the farthest Omen-symbol tile from the corpse. Jack's Spirit is a monster that moves and attacks heroes.

If Jack's Spirit returns to the traitor corpse tile, the traitor heals and returns to play.
reader.ending:
Heroes win when Jack's Spirit is exorcised and the survivors escape.

The traitor wins when every hero is dead and Crimson Jack's story remains in the house.
reader.endingSurvivors: A flash of light, a puff of smoke, and the smell of brimstone remain as Jack's Spirit vanishes. You hope you never see him again.
reader.endingTraitor: Whistle a happy tune. Your friends are cut to pieces, and you can finally settle back into the old house.

dust.title: The Dust
dust.objective: Heroes search for the cure and heal the Dust; the Dust wears them down with sickness.
dust.heroGoal: Find Research tokens, then cure the Dust.
dust.traitorGoal: Spread sickness and stop the cure.
dust.nextFallback: Search for cure or exchange sickness

reader.prologue: When the vial breaks, a wrong gray haze rises through the house. It crawls into throats, eyes, and wounds until the explorers cough, burn, and doubt each other.
reader.setup:
After Haunt 3, The Dust, each explorer receives sickness tokens. Some tokens can turn explorers into agents of the Dust.

Heroes need Research tokens from rooms before they can attempt the cure.
reader.heroes:
The hero route is direct: search for the cure, collect enough Research, then cure the Dust.

Explorers in the same room may exchange sickness tokens. Exchanges can concentrate safer tokens or expose who has already been compromised.
reader.special:
Research tokens represent progress against the Dust. Cure attempts use Research as help.

Sickness affects explorers as turns advance, so read both current traits and who carries sickness.
reader.traitor:
Explorers controlled by the Dust should delay research, spread sickness, and make cure attempts dangerous.

Stay close to heroes, force exchanges, and keep pressure on cure rooms.
reader.ending:
Heroes win when the Dust is cured and survivors break the sickness.

The Dust wins when sickness overtakes the explorers and only gray haze remains.
reader.endingSurvivors: You plunge a makeshift syringe into your arm, and your cough quickly ceases. You stop seeing red, but the dust particles continue to float throughout the house. You’d best leave quickly, before your immunity wears off.
reader.endingTraitor: The feverish rush out of the house to wreak havoc upon the town. Dust to dust.

bloodFromStone.title: Blood from a Stone
bloodFromStone.objective: Heroes make every Stone Cherub face another and vanish; the Haunt wears heroes down with staring stone.
bloodFromStone.heroGoal: Move, bait, and play Peekaboo to remove every Stone Cherub.
bloodFromStone.traitorGoal: No fixed traitor: the Stone Cherubs and the house threaten every hero.
bloodFromStone.nextFallback: Move beside a Cherub or into a Cherub's line of sight

reader.prologue: The statues are no longer decorations. Each time you turn away, they seem a little closer; each blink makes their stone smiles sharper.
reader.setup:
After Haunt 5, Blood from a Stone, Stone Cherubs enter the house. Place one in each hero's room first, then place the extra Cherubs outside hero line of sight when possible; if there are not enough rooms, players choose discovered rooms for the remaining Cherubs.

Stone Cherubs are not normal enemies and cannot be solved through ordinary attacks.
reader.heroes:
Heroes must make every Stone Cherub disappear. A hero may play Peekaboo when one Stone Cherub is on the same tile and another Stone Cherub is in line of sight.

Peekaboo is a Knowledge check; a Mirror helps. Success removes those two Cherubs. Failure causes general damage.
reader.special:
Stone Cherubs threaten heroes through line of sight. At the end of the monster turn, each hero also suffers queued gaze damage for Cherubs they can see.

Heroes need to use room position and line of sight to pair Cherubs into disappearing groups.
reader.monster:
Stone Cherubs are not defeated through ordinary attacks. They move toward heroes, but if they already begin in a hero's line of sight, they do not move that turn.

Their danger is position and sight, not a normal attack.
reader.ending:
Heroes win when the last pair of Stone Cherubs vanishes and the survivors escape.

The Haunt wins when every hero is dead and the Stone Cherubs claim the house.
reader.endingSurvivors: The final two Stone Cherubs stare at each other as cracks split their wings and smiles. When the rubble settles, the house is finally quiet.
reader.endingHaunt: When the last hero falls, the Stone Cherubs return to their places. Their smiles look more human than when you entered.

helpingHands.title: Helping Hands
helpingHands.objective: Free-for-all: take the Strange Amulet and be the last explorer alive.
helpingHands.heroGoal: Hold the Strange Amulet and use Troll Hand pressure against the other explorers.
helpingHands.traitorGoal: No fixed traitor: every explorer is an opponent.
helpingHands.nextFallback: Fight for the Strange Amulet and move the Troll Hands

reader.prologue: A chewing sound moves inside the walls. The house reaches out with hands that obey whoever holds the Strange Amulet.
reader.setup:
When “The House Is Hungry” triggers Haunt 12, Helping Hands, if no one has the Strange Amulet, search the item deck and give it to the haunt revealer.

Place the Monster Card to the revealer's left. Place one Troll Hand in the Entrance Hall and one in the Basement Landing. The player to the revealer's left takes the first turn.
reader.heroes:
Each explorer is trying to survive alone. You win by holding the Strange Amulet while every other explorer is dead.

The current Strange Amulet holder controls the Troll Hands. If no one has the amulet, skip the monster turn.
reader.special:
Troll Hands have Might 5, Speed 3, Sanity 4, and Knowledge 4, and cannot be stunned. If both Troll Hands are in the same room, they may make one combined Might 8 attack and both Troll Hands spend their attack for the turn.

When you win a Might attack against another explorer, you may steal one item or omen instead of dealing damage.
reader.traitor: This haunt has no fixed traitor and no hidden team. The Strange Amulet holder, Troll Hand locations, and monster controller are public.
reader.ending:
You win when you hold the Strange Amulet and every other explorer is dead.

If the Strange Amulet changes hands, Troll Hand control changes immediately.
reader.endingSurvivors: The Strange Amulet is still in your hand. The hands in the walls fall quiet, as if the house has accepted its new owner.
reader.endingTraitor: The Strange Amulet ends with the final winner. The other explorers have no more chances to escape the hands in the walls.

magicCamera.title: The Magic Camera
magicCamera.objective: The traitor captures Essence; heroes must smash the Magic Camera.
magicCamera.heroGoal: Find and smash the Magic Camera.
magicCamera.traitorGoal: Photograph heroes and capture every Essence.
magicCamera.nextFallback: Take a photo or smash the Magic Camera

reader.prologue: After the Magic Camera flashes, shadows inside the photographs start to move. The lens is not just recording reality; it is stealing Essence.
reader.setup: After Haunt 33, The Magic Camera, the Magic Camera holder becomes the traitor. Phantom photographers enter play, and hero Essence becomes the core win condition.
reader.heroes:
Heroes must stop the traitor from taking photos and ultimately smash the Magic Camera. While the camera survives, every hero Essence remains at risk.

If a hero can reach the camera holder, look for the smash-camera opportunity.
reader.special:
When the traitor photographs a hero, that hero's Essence is captured. Phantom photographers help pressure and attack heroes.

The goal card tracks captured Essence, remaining Essence, active photographers, and camera status.
reader.traitor: The traitor uses the Magic Camera to photograph heroes and capture all Essence. Protect the camera and use phantom photographers until every Essence is taken.
reader.ending:
Heroes win when the Magic Camera is smashed and trapped Essence returns.

The traitor wins when every hero Essence is captured and the shadows replace them.
reader.endingSurvivors: When the Magic Camera shatters, the trapped Essence returns to the bodies it belonged to. The shadows retreat, and the shutter falls silent.
reader.endingTraitor: When the last photograph develops, every hero's Essence is gone. The shadows in the prints look up and walk out in their place.

basicSetup.title: Core Turn: Use, Move, Explore
basicSetup.description: Start from the pre-haunt board, then use a possession, move, explore, and resolve a discovery check.

steps.setupRuntime: The haunt has not started yet. Walk through a core turn: read the board, use a possession, move, explore an unknown room, and resolve the discovery.
steps.objectiveAndTurn: Your goal is to keep exploring the house. The bottom actions are the main entry points: Move, Explore, Trade, Use, and End Turn.
steps.traitsAndSpeed: Read Speed before moving. Speed tells you the farthest you can move this turn.
steps.traitTrackReading: Read each trait as separate physical slots: the current slot is highlighted, the green number is the starting value, and the skull is death, not a number. Repeated values are still separate slots.
steps.movesRemaining: The movement medallion in the upper-right shows how many steps remain right now. It decreases as you move, so it may not equal your full Speed.
steps.roomBoard: The central room board is the main play area. Check where you are, which rooms connect, and where exploration can continue.
steps.observeTeammate: Click a teammate panel to observe that explorer and move the camera to that explorer's room. Click the same teammate again to return to the place you were viewing before, not always to yourself.
steps.focusSelfRoom: If you lose your place after panning the board, Focus My Room moves the camera back to your explorer's room. It is not a room details popup or the return control for teammate observation.
steps.hauntRiskTrack: Read the omen progress by slots: the highlighted slot is the number of discovered omens. The haunt-check details stay in hover help instead of filling the main HUD.
steps.inventoryAndHelp: The lower-left area is your inventory. Items and omens stay here; later use, trade, and effect choices start from these cards.
steps.useBook: Select the Book in your inventory, then click Use. The Book points the next non-combat check toward Knowledge.
steps.openMoveTargets: Now choose Move. Glowing rooms are places you can still reach this turn.
steps.moveToHallway: Move into the Hallway. It connects to a new exit, so the next step can reveal an unknown room.
steps.exploreUpper: Select the explorable face-down room. First choose the exit; the new room reveals into a placement preview.
steps.confirmRoomPlacement: After checking the room orientation and connected doorway, choose Confirm Placement. Only then does the room symbol resolve and draw the discovery card.
steps.finish: The discovery has entered a Knowledge check. After the dice stop, you may use Rabbit's Foot to reroll one die; continue only when you do not want to change the result.

omenConfirmation.title: Omen: Confirm and Haunt Progress
omenConfirmation.description: After drawing an omen, read the omen track, the single Confirm button, and why the haunt check appears on the same screen as the omen card.

steps.setupOmenConfirmation: Now look at an omen discovery. The omen card and haunt-check result belong to the same discovery, so they appear together in one result panel.
steps.hauntRiskTrack: This shows how many omens have been discovered. The highlighted slot is the current count; hover help expands how many dice roll and what total starts the haunt.
steps.confirmOmenCard: The omen card and haunt-check result are already on the same screen. After reading them, press Confirm once to close this discovery and return to the board.
steps.review: After confirmation, the omen is in your inventory and the board returns to pre-haunt play. This check did not start the haunt, so exploration continues.

tradeAndAgreement.title: Trade: Request, Then Agreement
tradeAndAgreement.description: In the same room, choose possessions from either side and a teammate, propose the trade, then let the other player accept or decline.

steps.setupTrade: Trading happens on the same tile. You may choose Items or Omens you give, and you may choose possessions the other explorer gives; both explorers must agree.
steps.chooseTradeItem: Select Rabbit's Foot in your inventory first. This only marks the possession you want to give; it does not move yet.
steps.chooseTradeTarget: Now select the teammate token in the same room. After the teammate is selected, that player's possessions appear beside the bottom trade flow; click any card you want that player to give.
steps.chooseTradeReturn: For this two-sided trade demo, click that player's Map. You can also leave their possessions unselected and propose a trade where only Rabbit's Foot moves.
steps.sendTradeRequest: The summary states what you give and what the other explorer gives. When it is correct, click Propose Trade; the receiver must respond before anything moves.
steps.requestWaiting: The request has been sent. The requester now only sees the waiting state; they cannot swap Rabbit's Foot and Map by themselves.
steps.acceptTradeRequest: Now view the request as the receiver. The panel lists requester gives Rabbit's Foot and receiver gives Map; Accept Trade resolves it, while Decline keeps both inventories unchanged.
steps.tradeReview: The trade has resolved. Map enters the requester inventory, Rabbit's Foot enters the teammate inventory, and the request panel clears back to the board.

hauntActions.title: After the Haunt: Read the Goal, Then Banish the Mummy
hauntActions.description: After the haunt begins, see why the goal changed before finishing the hero banishment check.

steps.setupReadyToExorcise: Exploration and omens can push the house into the haunt. This is now Mummy Rampage: heroes must find the true name, learn the banishment spell, and banish the mummy before the traitor completes the wedding.
steps.helpEntry: The goal has changed after the haunt: heroes are no longer just exploring. Open the haunt reference to confirm how the heroes and traitor each win.
steps.hauntActions: Banish Mummy is not appearing out of nowhere. The heroes have already found the true name and learned the banishment spell, so the last step is a Sanity contest in the mummy's room.
steps.exorciseJack: Use Banish Mummy now to make the Sanity check. Once the dice settle, compare the hero total against the mummy.
steps.banishMummy: Use Banish Mummy now to make the Sanity contest. Once the dice settle, compare the hero total against the mummy.
steps.endgameReview: The banishment succeeds. The mummy crumbles into sand, and the ending narration opens the final report.

heroAttackPath.title: Hero Attacks the Traitor
heroAttackPath.description: After opening the haunt reference, show how a hero uses the real attack entry to pressure the traitor.

steps.setupHeroAttack: Now look at the hero attack branch. The hero has investigated Jack; when the traitor is in the same room, the hero can attack to help release Jack's Spirit.
steps.heroAttackObjective: Open the haunt reference first. Heroes do more than exorcise: before the final exorcism, a hero may need to attack the traitor to advance the scenario.
steps.attackTraitor: Choose Attack Traitor first to enter target selection, then click the traitor token on the map. Both sides roll dice; because the hero investigated Jack, this attack gains an extra bonus.
steps.heroAttackReview: The hero attack has resolved. This view shows the attack dice, the bonus, and the result instead of only describing the rule.

jackSpiritPath.title: Jack's Spirit Acts
jackSpiritPath.description: After the traitor falls, show Jack's Spirit continuing as a monster that moves and attacks heroes.

steps.setupJackSpirit: After the traitor is knocked down, Jack's Spirit has appeared and becomes the active threat. It is not background text; it is a monster that keeps acting.
steps.jackSpiritObjective: Open the haunt reference first. Jack's Spirit attacks heroes and tries to return to the corpse room so the traitor can revive.
steps.jackSpiritAttack: Choose Attack Hero first to enter target selection, then click the hero token in the same room for the monster attack. Jack's Spirit uses the same real attack roll flow.
steps.jackSpiritReview: Jack's Spirit attack has resolved. The same attack dice table shows the dice, total, and outcome.

traitorPath.title: Helping the Mummy
traitorPath.description: Switch to the traitor side, pick up the Girl, give her to the Mummy, hand over the Holy Symbol, and trigger the traitor ending.

steps.setupTraitorTurn: Now switch to the traitor side. The traitor does not banish the Mummy; the traitor wins by helping the Mummy return to the Sarcophagus with the Girl and either the Holy Symbol or the Ring.
steps.traitorObjective: Open the Traitor's Tome first. The goal is the Girl, one required omen, and the Sarcophagus all coming together before the heroes banish the Mummy.
steps.pickUpGirl: The Girl token is in this room. Choose Pick Up Girl to move her from the room token into the traitor's public custody.
steps.giveGirlToMummy: The traitor is in the same room as the Mummy. Choose Give Girl to move the Girl from the traitor to the Mummy.
steps.giveOmenToMummy: The Mummy has the Girl and still needs the Holy Symbol or the Ring. Choose Give Holy Symbol so the Mummy carries the required omen in the Sarcophagus room.
steps.traitorFinish: The Mummy returns to the Sarcophagus with the Girl and the Holy Symbol, so the traitor wins. This shows the ending narration and final report.

mummyMonsterActions.title: Mummy Monster Actions
mummyMonsterActions.description: Switch to the Mummy's monster turn and complete movement, forced attack, and the steal reward.

steps.setupMonsterMove: Now watch the Mummy's own monster turn. It starts in the Sarcophagus room, the Girl is in a distant room, and the traitor controls the Mummy.
steps.monsterTurnStart: Choose Start Mummy. This moves the Mummy from goal text back into the real monster action slot.
steps.monsterRoll: Choose Mummy Movement. The dice table shows how far the Mummy may move this turn.
steps.monsterRollReview: This movement roll is 0. On 0 or 1, the Mummy may teleport to any discovered room. Read it, then return to the board.
steps.monsterMoveTarget: Choose Move Mummy, click the Mummy token, then click the discovered room with the Girl. Undiscovered rooms are not targets.
steps.monsterMoveResult: After the Mummy teleports to the Girl's room, the Girl token becomes held by the Mummy. This is a board result, not a log summary.
steps.setupAttack: Now check same-room combat. The Mummy, the traitor, and one living hero share a room, and the hero carries the Map and Holy Symbol.
steps.attackForced: When the Mummy shares a room with a hero, Mummy Attack appears first. It cannot move away before attacking.
steps.attackTarget: Choose Mummy Attack, then click the Mummy token and the hero in the same room. The traitor and dead explorer are not attack targets.
steps.attackRollReview: The attack dice table shows both sides' dice, totals, and outcome. If the Mummy deals enough damage, it may choose damage or steal. Read it, then return to the board.
steps.attackReward: Choose Steal Map here. Stealing replaces this damage and transfers the item from the hero to the Mummy.
steps.stealResult: The Mummy has taken the Map, the reward bar is closed, and the board feedback shows the steal result.
